name: table
body: A GFM table parsed from a body whose template declares the `tables` option (gfm-tables, table-opt-in): a header row, a delimiter row and zero or more body rows of cells (domain.value.table-cell), each column carrying an alignment (domain.value.table-alignment). It is parsed per GFM's table extension with strict column counts — every row's cell count equals the header's, and a mismatch is an error rather than GFM's padding/truncation (table-syntax) — and is bounded by the template's declared limits (domain.value.table-limits). It belongs to a body (domain.value.body) and is exposed to the template's layout under `.table`/`.tables` (table-layout-context). The authored syntax is GFM's: leading and trailing pipes optional, cells trimmed, `\|` a literal pipe, cell content inline Markdown, the table ending at a blank line or the start of another block.
